title: The Short-Run Effects of the General Data Protection Regulation on Technology Venture Investment
eligible_reason: Single adoption dates: all EU countries are treated at the GDPR announcement (eu_postgdpr_ann) and implementation (eu_postgdpr_imp) dates, so the design is EU x post with two common break dates, not staggered. Main models are Poisson (nonlinear) with country, year-month and sub-category fixed effects and time-varying macro controls (unemp gdp cpi interest); OLS columns (areg ln_dealsplus1) keep the same controls. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule, the no-controls rule and the linear-model rule.
design_notes: Country x sub-category x year-month deal counts (GDPR_Short_Run.dta), EU vs US (row==0) or EU vs rest of world (row==1). Table 3: xi: poisson number_deals eu gdpr_ann eu_postgdpr_ann gdpr_imp eu_postgdpr_imp i.sub_category_code i.yymm i.country_code $macro, cluster(country_code); OLS version with areg absorb(country_code). Table 4 adds regulation_strictness interactions; Table 5 sub-category splits; Table 6 Cambridge Analytica placebo (CA_sample.dta). Pre-trend test with EU x month leads.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Common GDPR announcement (Apr 2016) and implementation (May 2018) dates for all EU countries.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption dates (EU x post); Poisson; time-varying macro controls
specs.treatment_var: eu_postgdpr_ann, eu_postgdpr_imp (with eu, gdpr_ann, gdpr_imp main effects)
specs.sample_condition: row==0 (EU vs US) or row==1 (EU vs ROW), sub_category_code < 5

specs.notes: Tables 4-6 are variants (strictness interactions, sub-category splits, Cambridge Analytica placebo).

data_files: Crunchbase_data_clean.ipynb, VentureXpert_dataClean.ipynb, Get_final_sample.ipynb (Python cleaning code for the licensed raw data)
data_files_note: The do-file header states 'We use the simulated data to test the code. You could use the same code here to get the results if you follow the steps in our Data Sharing Letter to get the final sample.' Raw data are licensed (Crunchbase, VentureXpert). Shipped .dta files are simulated, so data_access = synthetic.
software_notes: Stata (xi: poisson, areg, outreg2); Python notebooks for data construction.
priority_note: Not a staggered design; shipped data simulated.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no README file; design read from gdpr_short_run_code.do). No abstract beyond a one-line summary in frame.csv.
